_comment: Named test games. `teams` is a mix of styles of play, standing in for how guests might actually behave. They are a testing instrument, not a prediction.

scenarios.name: 10 teams, mixed play
scenarios.description: The current design: three items each, one decision a round (where do we go, and which subject do we fancy being asked about), and a trivia matchup wherever two teams land together.

scenarios.name: everybody plays to their strengths
scenarios.description: Every team heads for the subject it reckons it knows. Does picking your theme beat chasing treasure?

scenarios.name: everybody plays it safe
scenarios.description: Worst case: every team avoids the busy places. Does the game still produce a showdown?

scenarios.name: everybody chases the treasure
scenarios.description: Worst case: every team goes for the richest spot. Does the field wipe itself out?

scenarios.name: 6 teams
scenarios.description: A smaller gathering on the same board.
